newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: Bolivians reject proposal to postpone polls.
newsitem.headline: Bolivians reject proposal to postpone polls.

text.p: Bolivian political parties, unions and officials rejected on Friday a government's proposal to postpone a month the general polls scheduled for June 1997.
"It is not technically possible. The postponement could risk the hand-over August 6th," Alfredo Bocangel, head of the country's electoral court told journalists.

The government said on Thursday two months between the polls and the hand-over was too long a period that could result in a vacuum of power that could even put in jeopardy the economic stability. But its proposal for the polls to be conducted just a month ahead of the inauguration of the new government was widely rejected.
